records.title: DIVYANGJAN KAUSHAL VIKAS YOJANA
details:
The scheme is presently in formulation stage. The detailed implementation framework, 
methodology for development of specialised training modules, provisions relating to barrier-free 
infrastructure and assistive technologies, as well as mechanisms for market linkages and 
sustainable livelihood generation for trained beneficiaries, are being finalised in consultation 
with various stakeholders.
